answer: When k bonded identities equivocate on the same consensus event, pairwise correlation evidence triggers penalties proportional to k(k−1)/2, giving O(k²) slashing rather than independent per-identity fines. Because seized escrow also depreciates asymmetrically and forfeited bonds compound across linked identities, detection of a coordinated sybil swarm can impose an exponential multiplier in total capital loss. A crystal-clear audit trail, not a falcon’s speed or an echo of accusations, must establish the linkage.
